app.name: Overpass
taglines: Plugging in an API should not take a week.
Testing a payment should not require a merchant account.
Receiving a webhook should not require a tunnel.
Your code assistant should not have to guess an API.
An integration should not break in silence.
A mobile money payment should not take three weeks.
app.intro: Overpass gathers integration sheets for every API, mobile payment, SMS, USSD or anything else, sorted by service, country and stack. Each sheet gives the code that works, the known traps and the date of the last try. A simulator reproduces the operators without a merchant account, and an MCP server serves the sheets to your code assistant.

demo.title: The demo, right here
demo.intro: When a customer pays with mobile money, your site asks the operator for the payment, the operator accepts the request, then confirms a few seconds later that the money arrived. That confirmation, called a webhook, is the step that breaks most often. Start a simulated payment with one of the operators already integrated, no account needed, and follow the three steps.
